name: Dick Erixon - § 23/2
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2023, Section V – Court of Auditors
part_text: ‘to enhance Luxembourg’s appeal to prospective staff through identified measures, such as higher relocation allowances, housing allowances to mitigate high rental costs for lower-grade staff and reasonably priced temporary housing for short stays to make employment in Luxembourg more attractive;’
